title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version preserves the existing reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and repair/source ZIPs while adding one compact SGA5 repair032 audit-support bundle: SGA5_repair032_audit_support_20260624.zip.

Status at a glance. This is a substantial working-draft and repair record, not a globally certified complete edition and not a critical edition. The SGA5 material is explicitly not complete and should be assumed to contain many remaining errors unless a later, narrower source-audit packet promotes a specific locus.

Current SGA5 audit caveat. Workflow/agent passes are finders and repair evidence, not certifiers. The p69 scope note clarifies that the source scan is the full 484-page LNM 589, but the local TeX is a curated 10-expose selection (I, III, IIIB, V, VI, VII, VIII, X, XII, XV). Current local workpass evidence is page-local, not global SGA5 certification.

New file in this version. SGA5_repair032_audit_support_20260624.zip bundles the local repair032 final packet, p205-p226 microaudit packet, remaining-error web-drop, README, and checksum manifest. The bundle is included so the current local repair/audit evidence is preserved in one slot on a record already at Zenodo file-count pressure.

File-surface curation note. The SGA record is at Zenodo's 100-file ceiling. This version removes the obsolete tiny sga_repair019_public_summary.json file from the latest file surface in order to add the repair032 audit-support bundle. Earlier versions preserve previous files.

Filename warning. Older filenames containing words such as Complete, Strict, Source-Checked, or High-Fidelity are legacy package names and are not current global certification claims. Source-witness and aid ZIPs are locator/check layers, not textual authority by themselves. Treat SGA6 and SGA7 as substantial working drafts with explicit compression/source-check caveats unless a specific later packet declares source-checked coverage.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

Local SGA5 workpass cursor update, 2026-06-26. A newer local SGA5 control/webdrop package, SGA5_FullAudit_WebDrop_p001_p254_certified_staged_p255_p484_20260626.zip (379,545,322 bytes, SHA256 8A3CD01CCD276167CEA31F81523AA6B97DEA0AAF0501DA0B4ECF75788667AB54), records page-local French workpass/audit evidence through the public wrapper boundary p254, with p255 next. p255-p484 are included as staged source witnesses only; their presence does not promote those pages. p250-p254 close Expose V and open Expose VI; p254 closes section 1.1.4 and opens section 1.2 with Definition 1.2.1 and Example 1.2.2 on Z_l(1). The embedded logs contain p255 planning/check text, but the package wrapper caps the public boundary at p254; do not promote p255 until a later wrapper or deliberate review resolves that boundary. This remains source-audit/workpass evidence only: not complete SGA5, not synchronized English, not global source-faithfulness certification, and not a critical edition. Local ledger terms such as certified or complete are interpreted as page-local workpass status only.
